title: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Malfunction
symptoms: MIL or pending monitor evidence may be present
Complaint should be reproduced in warm idle mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: MAF/MAP should move coherently with RPM and throttle; disagreement raises sensor or airflow suspicion. Capture context: engine warm, closed loop, stable idle.
recommendedChecks: Compare MAF/MAP/IAT against RPM, load and fuel trims.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: RPM roughness, cylinder counters and trim/O2 disturbance should align around the affected event. Capture context: sustained high load.
recommendedChecks: Use cylinder counters, ignition stress and compression tests.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in closed throttle decel mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: MAF/MAP should move coherently with RPM and throttle; disagreement raises sensor or airflow suspicion. Capture context: deceleration fuel cut and high vacuum.
recommendedChecks: Compare MAF/MAP/IAT against RPM, load and fuel trims.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in after heat soak mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: MAF/MAP should move coherently with RPM and throttle; disagreement raises sensor or airflow suspicion. Capture context: restart after heat soak.
recommendedChecks: Compare MAF/MAP/IAT against RPM, load and fuel trims.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in 1500 rpm stationary mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: RPM roughness, cylinder counters and trim/O2 disturbance should align around the affected event. Capture context: no-load raised idle check.
recommendedChecks: Use cylinder counters, ignition stress and compression tests.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in hybrid engine on mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: RPM roughness, cylinder counters and trim/O2 disturbance should align around the affected event. Capture context: hybrid engine starts/stops and limited warmup window.
recommendedChecks: Use cylinder counters, ignition stress and compression tests.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in bank 2 only mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: MAF/MAP should move coherently with RPM and throttle; disagreement raises sensor or airflow suspicion. Capture context: single bank signal separation.
recommendedChecks: Compare MAF/MAP/IAT against RPM, load and fuel trims.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in wot low rpm mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: Downstream O2 activity should be evaluated only after mixture and misfire are controlled. Capture context: wide-open throttle from low RPM.
recommendedChecks: Do not condemn catalyst before mixture, misfire and exhaust leak checks.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in low voltage event mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: Fuel trim should react when purge flow changes; after refuel and idle are high-value windows. Capture context: charging and module-voltage stress.
recommendedChecks: Command or isolate purge and watch fuel trim response.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

Complaint should be reproduced in wot high rpm mode
Do not replace parts from the DTC alone
signalPattern: Voltage/reference instability can make unrelated sensors fail together. Capture context: wide-open throttle near high RPM.
recommendedChecks: Load-test power, ground and sensor reference circuits.
Record at least RPM, load, throttle, MAP/MAF when available, trims, voltage and DTC freeze-frame.
Confirm repair by repeating the same operating mode and checking that the abnormal graph pattern disappears.
postRepairVerification: Clear or observe adaptations as appropriate, then repeat the same graph capture window.

signalPattern: RPM-speed relation separates engine torque loss from driveline slip. Capture context: moisture-sensitive ignition or connector test.
